snippet.title: Accept the Puppet's Invitation, Raise the Curtain on Tragedy | The Puppet's Casket PV Premiere
snippet.description:
If you wish to fulfill your ambition, then enter the manor,
to seize Caspian Thorne's treasure and... the secret of immortality.
——————————————
Rumor has it that within the mysterious Puppet Manor lies the astonishing wealth of the Thorne family.
Puppeteers flock to it, but their journeys often end with no return.
This time, however, the puppet Galatea has delivered an invitation to you.
Will your ending be different?

The independent puzzle game The Puppet's Casket is now available for wishlisting. Use your wits to solve puzzles and uncover the tragedy and secrets hidden deep within the manor...

Wishlist & demo link: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4240260
